title: AWS gives developers a free local stand-in for its cloud, built from scratch by AI agents
snippet: AWS released AWS Emulator, a free tool that simulates more than 200 AWS services on a developer's own machine, and says AI agents wrote all of its code without review by its engineers. Agents also maintain the emulator, testing it against the real AWS cloud and fixing the gaps they find. Read More

title: How Adobe Is Helping Disney with Custom AI Tools
snippet: Adobe and Disney have entered a multi-year partnership to help develop custom AI models and tools that the entertainment giant can use across its theme parks, studio and sports ‌media businesses. Deepa Subramaniam, Vice President of Product Marketing for Creative Professionals at Adobe, explains how it all works with Riley Griffin on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Take-Two’s Zelnick on Success of the GTA Franchise
snippet: Take-Two Interactive CEO Strauss Zelnick talks about the highly anticipated release of Grand Theft Auto VI, out next week. He says the Grand Theft Auto franchise “is probably the most valuable intellectual property in the entertainment business” because of its enormous global reach. Zelnick sits down with David Rubenstein on this week’s episode of The David Rubenstein Show: Peer to Peer Conversations. This interview was recorded October 19 in New York. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Nvidia China Scandal Demands Answers, Says Congressman
snippet: Rep. Raja Krishnamoorthi says Congress needs answers from Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang over his reported relationship with a woman suspected of ties to Chinese intelligence, and says lawmakers could consider a subpoena if Huang doesn’t voluntarily appear. The Illinois Democrat also calls for a review of Nvidia’s China export licenses and tougher controls designed to prevent advanced US chips from reaching restricted Chinese entities. He joins Riley Griffin on “Bloomberg Tech.” (Source: Bloomberg)

title: United Blocks AI Agents From Booking Flights Ahead of Holidays
snippet: United Airlines Holdings Inc. is moving to block third-party artificial intelligence agents from booking flights and accessing customer accounts ahead of the holiday travel season, as the growing use of AI in the airline industry raises concerns about privacy.

title: Anthropic IPO Demand Surges as CoreWeave Calms AI Fears

Plus, CoreWeave reassures Wall Street with third-quarter sales topping analyst estimates and easing fears about the debt tied to its rapid AI buildout; and Congressman Raja Krishnamoorthi discusses how the Nvidia scandal is felt across Washington and beyond. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: [Перевод] Чуть больше ста строк на C и курсы валют для IRC-бота: 30 лет curl глазами автора

Через несколько дней их нашёл Даниэль Стенберг: ему нужно было раз в день забирать курсы валют для IRC-бота.
